text_block_list.text:
While shopping, won tickets to Horse Girl 
martial arts event.

Came to watch, thinking might be useful 
reference...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Heading back. Better off lifting 
weights than watching this junk.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, my, why jump to conclusions? Match 
hasn't even begun yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You said "Kinematic observation and muscle 
analysis", so went along... What the hell 
is this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I care about "running". Not spectating 
childish brawl.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Sipping juice and happily spectating, go 
do that with your pals.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Racing and combat both involve body usage, 
plenty of common ground, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah, pointless.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Oi. Crowded, can't get out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Popular match, naturally. Never mind that, 
look at those Horse Girl fighters' 
physiques!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Can guess how they built them... How do 
they use them? Intensely curious!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Listen to me! Tch, whatever...
Soon match began.

Clash of power and speed far beyond humans 
had crowd roaring with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, Shakur-kun? What did you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Every one of 'em has insane whole-body 
spring. Conditioned in ways I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If they applied that to running, what 
happens? Wouldn't lose, but might be 
decent match.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fumu, fumu! And?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Different routes, but climbing same 
mountain called "Mastering physical 
form"...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, climbing same mountain! Quite poetic. 
Do share more of your insights with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Talked too much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Leaving now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, where are you going? Your poem must 
have more verses! Come, continue recital!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut the hell up already!!
